Dynamon Limited.reason: Dynamon provides advanced data analytics and simulation software (such as its flagship ZERO package) designed for commercial fleet decarbonisation and optimization. Its tools integrate with and analyze existing vehicle telematics and routing data rather than providing the core GPS hardware or primary vehicle telematics platform itself. It fits the 'compliance software that integrates other vendors' telematics' and OEM data APIs/add-on analytics classification within adjacent sectors.
